class.name: CgameClusterSimulator
class.brief_description: Deterministic in-process simulation of a cluster of game servers with injected faults.
class.description: [CgameClusterSimulator] runs N servers in one process to exercise the cross-server components together: item moves through [CgameTransactionCoordinator] 2PC, [CgameGuildSync] replication, [CgamePartyMigration], region leases with fencing ([CgameOwnershipLeases]) and load-based region reassignment ([CgameWorldSharding]) with player migration. Messages travel through a queue with random latency, so they reorder. A crashed server stops processing but keeps its durable state, and messages addressed to it are held until it restarts. The coordinator can be made to crash before or after its decision. Everything derives from one seeded [RandomNumberGenerator], so a run is reproducible: the same seed and calls give the same [member stats]. After a run, call [method quiesce] to heal and drain the cluster and [method check_invariants] to verify item conservation, absence of duplicates, finished transactions, converged guilds and parties and consistent leases. [codeblock] var sim := CgameClusterSimulator.new() sim.setup(4, 42) sim.add_player("p0", Vector2(50, 50), 3) sim.run_random(350) assert(sim.quiesce()) assert(sim.check_invariants().is_empty()) sim.teardown() [/codeblock]

method.name: setup
method.description: Creates [param servers] servers, seeds the generator, assigns the region grid round-robin and takes a lease for every region.

method.name: teardown
method.description: Clears the coordinator's participants. Call it when finished with the simulator.

method.name: ledger
method.description: Returns the ledger of server [param i].

method.name: guilds
method.description: Returns the guild replica of server [param i].

method.name: parties
method.description: Returns the party directory of server [param i].

method.name: is_alive
method.description: Returns whether server [param i] is up.

method.name: mint_item
method.description: Mints an item on a server and returns its id.

method.name: add_player
method.description: Adds a player at [param pos] on the server owning that region and mints [param items_count] items for them.

method.name: player_server
method.description: Returns the server currently owning the player.

method.name: create_party
method.description: Creates a party on the leader's server, adds [param members] and replicates it.

method.name: move_items
method.description: Moves items between servers with a 2PC. Returns [code]"committed"[/code], [code]"aborted"[/code], [code]"crashed"[/code] or [code]"rejected"[/code] (a precondition failed and nothing started).

method.name: migrate_player
method.description: Hands a player and their items to another server: freeze, 2PC item move, ownership flip. Returns the same outcomes as [method move_items].

method.name: guild_op
method.description: Applies a guild operation ([code]"join"[/code], [code]"rank"[/code], [code]"kick"[/code], [code]"motd"[/code] or deposit) on a server and queues it for the others.

method.name: gossip_pair
method.description: Runs a two-way anti-entropy exchange between two live servers.

method.name: region_loads
method.description: Returns the number of players standing in each region.

method.name: server_load_report
method.description: Returns the per-server player load.

method.name: rebalance
method.description: Reassigns hot regions, hands their leases over with fresh fencing tokens and migrates the players standing in them. Returns the region moves.

method.name: migrate_misplaced_players
method.description: Migrates every player whose region is owned by another server. Returns how many committed.

method.name: parties_settled
method.description: Returns whether every party member and its home sit on the leader's server.

method.name: crash_server
method.description: Stops server [param i] for [param down_for] ticks.

method.name: restart_server
method.description: Brings server [param i] back immediately.

method.name: live_count
method.description: Returns the number of running servers.

method.name: recover_coordinator
method.description: Runs the coordinator's recovery and finishes the affected transactions.

method.name: step
method.description: Advances one tick: restarts, coordinator recovery, message delivery, lease renewal and failover, party reconciliation and occasional gossip.

method.name: run_random
method.description: Runs a random workload with faults (item moves, guild edits, server and coordinator crashes, player and party migrations, rebalancing) for [param ticks] ticks.

method.name: idle
method.description: Returns whether no message is in flight, no transaction is pending and the coordinator is up.

method.name: quiesce
method.description: Heals everything: restarts servers, recovers the coordinator, drains queues, runs anti-entropy and lets parties converge. Returns [code]false[/code] if the cluster did not settle.

method.name: check_invariants
method.description: Returns human-readable violations (empty means all good). Call it after [method quiesce].
